title: Rescheduling inside 24 hours
body: Confirm the appointment slot and route the request to scheduling. Do not promise a fee waiver. Record the reason using the approved operational category and ask the scheduling lead to review exceptions.

title: Late arrival workflow
body: At 10 minutes late, notify the front desk. The front desk checks clinician capacity before confirming whether the visit can proceed. Offer rescheduling when the slot cannot be preserved.
